assignment.title: Practical Assignment — My First Design
assignment.description:
Welcome to your first practical assignment.

This is your first time creating a design as a UCA Graphic Design student.

So don't overthink it.

You are not expected to create a professional flyer.

You are not expected to create something perfect.

You are simply going to take what you have learned this week, open your design software, experiment with it, and create your first piece of design work.
assignment.instructions:
YOUR TASK

Create a simple poster that introduces you as a new graphic designer.

Your design must contain:

MY NAME IS [YOUR NAME]

and

THIS IS MY FIRST DESIGN WORK AS A STUDENT OF UCA.

You can arrange these words however you want.


DESIGN REQUIREMENTS

Create your design using the software for your chosen pathway:

Smartphone Graphic Design: PixelLab
PC Graphic Design: Adobe Photoshop

Canvas Size

1080 × 1440 pixels

Background

Use a black background.

Everything else is up to you.

You can experiment with:

- Text
- Different fonts
- Font sizes
- Shapes
- Images
- Positioning
- Spacing
- Alignment
- Other basic tools you have explored

You are encouraged to experiment with the software.

Try things.

Move things around.

See what happens.

This is your first opportunity to actually create something.


THERE IS NO PERFECT DESIGN

We know you are a beginner.

You have only just been introduced to your design software.

Therefore, this assignment will not be judged primarily by how beautiful or professional your design looks.

What matters is your attempt.

Did you actually experiment?

Did you make an effort to create something rather than leaving the canvas almost empty?

Did you try using some of the tools you were introduced to?

Did you make intentional choices about how your design looks?

Don't worry if your design isn't perfect.

You're just getting started.


THE CHALLENGE

Give yourself permission to experiment.

You could make your name large.

You could make the statement small.

You could experiment with different fonts.

You could add simple shapes.

You could create an interesting arrangement.

You could keep it extremely minimal.

There is no single correct way to do it.

This is your first design. Make it yours.


YOUR SUBMISSION

Once you have finished:

1. Export your design.

Save your completed design as an image.

2. Post it on your Instagram page.

This is compulsory.

Your work should be published on your usual UCA/design-related social media page.

3. Write your caption.

Your caption should include:

"What I learned from UCA this week:"

Then briefly share what you learned during your first week.

You can also add a personal declaration about the designer you want to become.

4. Copy the link to your Instagram post.

5. Submit the link on the UCA Assignment Platform.

Your work will be reviewed there.


DEADLINE

Assignment Period:

Wednesday – Friday

Final Deadline:

Friday, 11:59 PM

Make sure your assignment is posted and submitted before the deadline.

Don't wait until the last minute.


ONE LAST THING

Don't compare your first design to someone who has been designing for years.

You're not supposed to be good yet.

You're supposed to start.

This is Design #001.

Let's see where you are by the end of UCA.
assignment.requirements:
WHAT WILL BE CONSIDERED

Because this is your first-ever design assignment, we are not expecting professional-level work.

Your work will mainly be considered based on:

1. COMPLETION
Did you actually complete the assignment?

2. EFFORT
Did you make a genuine attempt rather than submitting an almost empty canvas?

3. EXPERIMENTATION
Did you explore some of the tools and features you were introduced to?

4. PRESENTATION
Did you make an effort to arrange your elements in an intentional way?

5. SUBMISSION
Did you correctly post your work and submit the link before the deadline?

Don't worry about being perfect.

You will get much better as the course progresses.


FINAL CHECKLIST

Before submitting, make sure:

☐ My canvas is 1080 × 1440 pixels

☐ My background is black

☐ I included my name

☐ I included "This is my first design work as a student of UCA."

☐ I created the design using my assigned design software

☐ I experimented with some of the tools I learned this week

☐ I made an actual attempt to create something

☐ I exported my final design

☐ I posted it on Instagram

☐ My caption includes "What I learned from UCA this week:"

☐ I copied my Instagram post link

☐ I submitted the link on the UCA Assignment Platform

☐ I submitted before Friday, 11:59 PM
